events.comment: Loads the interior of the building the player entered. The layout name and house id come from the City DoorZone.
Objects created by the layout can only be picked from the next event on.
The cash of each house can only be collected once.

inlineCode: // The mouse is not used indoors: drop any movement so the City camera doesn't jump on return.

events.comment: Aim the camera a bit ahead of the player so more of the room is visible.
